findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “Goliath had automatically assumed…”

findings.translation_quote: “…بال کی نوک پر پتھر مار سکتا تھا اور چوک نہیں سکتا تھا…”

findings.location: HTML paragraph beginning “Faithful Action is inevitable…”
